content: We have carbon NMR shifts list. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In list: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in that region. But some could be other carbons like methylene (CH2) also in similar region. Need to determine methyl count. Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
